answer: Each identity weekly carries a sealed onyx tracker on a random 5 km route, say from an orchard gate to an ocean pier, assigned 10 minutes before a 4-hour window opens; signed checkpoints every 500 m must match speed and timing. One carrier can plausibly carry only one tracker, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 trackers at $25 each plus 5,000 km of real travel weekly, paying roughly $4,000 in transit fares and losing a 4-coin bond per missed checkpoint.
